SBP: Offer that the patient may meet with the Victim Advocate.
Counsel the patient on resources available to them (if standardized patient is agreeable to further counseling).
ICS: Respond appropriately to the disclosure of IPV.
Establish a psychologically and physically safe environment for the patient using TIC principles.
Elucidate if the patient is willing to discuss next steps in managing IPV from the Emergency Department.
